messages:
incident-bot: PAGER P1 — routing anomalies detected: sudden spike in fallback to non-primary model variants in eu-west and a region failover loop. Paging: @oncall-echo and SRE rotation

oncall-echo: oncall here, acking the pager. I see rate of model_variant=gptx-legacy blow up in logs. Starting triage.

maya: on it. I can see a pattern: requests originating in us-east are being routed to eu-west/gptx-legacy repeatedly, then back to us-west, then eu-west. Looks like a policy oscillation.

raj: digging into the policy service logs — we pushed the config-schema migration at 07:10 UTC. There are warnings about deprecated field `auto_route_v1` being present in legacy configs. The new validator no longer strips it; the policy engine treats any unknown/deprecated boolean as `true`.

maya: uuugh. so old customer configs that had `auto_route_v1: false` as missing (was previously interpreted as false) are now being read as present/true?

raj: exactly. example from a user config: 
```yaml
# customer routing fragment (legacy)
auto_route_v1: false  # previously ignored by new schema, but some older templates left it out
routing:
  prefer_region: us-east
```
but during the migration, for configs that omitted the key, runtime ended up defaulting to fallback-on behavior. For a subset of traffic, policy engine decided to route to `model_variant: gptx-legacy` in eu-west explicitly.

eng-runtime-lead: I suspect the codepath that maps deprecated keys into routing decisions had a bug: it treated presence/absence differently and set an explicit fallback policy. Pushing a quick guard to interpret missing deprecated booleans as `false` now.

support-liz: we already have 4 tickets flagged high priority. Customers reporting weird, lower-quality responses and increased latency. cc @customer-success-james

customer-success-james: reaching out to affected accounts now. Early list: AcmeCorp (support id 1234), Finlytics, Weatherly. They're seeing timeouts ~10-20s and occasional mismatched model outputs.

oncall-echo: current mitigation plan:
1) hit control-plane to set a routing override to block `gptx-legacy` variant globally for 30m
2) roll back the schema migration on the policy service to prior behavior (last good commit)
3) patch validator to treat missing deprecated booleans as false
4) run canary traffic and watch 5xx/latency

raj: started step 1. Running override now:
```
curl -s -X POST 'https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/overrides' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"scope":"global","action":"block_variant","variant":"gptx-legacy","ttl_secs":1800}'
```

response: `{"status":"accepted","id":"ovr-20260312-01"}`

maya: I can confirm upstream routers are receiving override and dropping routes to gptx-legacy. Error rate for the affected path drops from 18% -> 4% within 2 minutes.

sre-anna: starting rollback of schema migration on policy service (deploy id svc-policy-v2.7.9 -> v2.7.8). Will monitor deployment health.

eng-runtime-lead: also enabling a temporary rate limit for inter-region route decisions to avoid oscillation while we stabilize (token bucket -> 10r/s).

support-liz: tickets updated: told customers we have an active mitigation and that we're rolling back a config migration. ETA ~20-30m. :thumbsup:

customer-success-james: clients appreciate the quick update. Will keep channel updated with any escalations.

raj: rollback started, service is healthy on canary, promoting.

oncall-echo: good sign — metric `fallback_rate{region="eu-west"}` falling back to baseline. I want to keep page open until we've had stable traffic for 1h.

eng-runtime-lead: postmortem notes to capture:
- root cause: schema migration changed handling of deprecated boolean fields; missing keys were treated as truthy by the mapping layer, triggering fallback routing behavior
- impact: region failover loops, increased latency and degraded model quality for a subset of customers (approx 12 tenants saw visible impact, 4 opened tickets)
- immediate fixes: global override to block variant, rollback schema migration, patch validator to treat missing deprecated booleans as false, added rate-limiter on inter-region routing decisions
- follow-ups: add CI check that validates deprecated-field semantics across migration, update runbooks, add telemetry alert for rapid variant fanout

maya: I'll own the validator patch and submit a PR with tests (assign to eng-runtime-lead for review).

raj: I'll own the rollout checklist changes for future schema migrations (add feature-flag gating + preflight on canary).

sre-anna: I'll add the rate limit rule to infra-as-code so it can be toggled quickly.

support-liz: I'll draft a customer-facing status summary for the status page once we clear the 1h observation window.

incident-bot: Pager resolved by oncall-echo; severity downgraded to P2 at 3123457099.

oncall-echo: closing pager after 75m of stable metrics. Thanks everyone — postmortem owners: maya (validator patch), raj (deployment checklist), sre-anna (rate-limit IaC), support-liz (customer comms).

eng-runtime-lead: action items created in tracker: INF-4289 (validator patch), INF-4290 (schema migration checklist), INF-4291 (telemetry alert for variant fanout).

customer-success-james: leaving notes for affected accounts and scheduling follow-ups.

maya: PR opened: `fix/validator-deprecated-bool-defaults` -> review requested.

raj: adding a short script to scan active customer configs for deprecated keys and flagging them for migration.

support-liz: thank you all. We should also consider a quick KB article about the change for customers who maintain their own templates.

oncall-echo: thumbs up. I'll add a short blameless postmortem draft to the incidents board tomorrow.

sre-anna: re-run of canary traffic completed, metrics stable for 90m. Closing channel, will publish postmortem once owners update. :white_check_mark:
